INSERT IGNORE INTO biz_prompt_comment( comment_id, prompt_id, operate_group_id, title, comment_content, remark, version, del_flag, create_dept, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, tenant_id, xhs_intercept_count, xhs_normal_count ) VALUES
( #{item.commentId}, #{item.promptId}, #{item.operateGroupId}, #{item.title}, #{item.commentContent}, #{item.remark}, 0, 0, #{item.createDept}, #{item.createBy}, #{item.createTime}, #{item.updateBy}, #{item.updateTime}, #{item.tenantId}, #{item.xhsInterceptCount}, #{item.xhsNormalCount} )
mapper.select: SELECT t1.comment_id, t1.prompt_id, t1.title, t1.comment_content, t1.remark, t1.version, t1.create_dept, t1.create_by, t1.create_time, t1.update_by, t1.update_time, t1.tenant_id, t1.xhs_intercept_count, t1.xhs_normal_count FROM biz_prompt_comment t1 LEFT JOIN biz_prompt_comment_complete t2 ON t1.comment_id = t2.comment_id AND t2.media_account_id = #{mediaAccountId} LEFT JOIN biz_prompt_template t3 ON t1.prompt_id = t3.prompt_id WHERE t1.del_flag = '0' AND t2.comment_complete_id IS NULL AND t3.template_type = #{platform} LIMIT 100

SELECT t1.comment_id, t1.prompt_id, t1.operate_group_id, t1.title, t1.comment_content, t1.remark, t1.version, t1.create_dept, t1.create_by, t1.create_time, t1.update_by, t1.update_time, t1.tenant_id, t1.xhs_intercept_count, t1.xhs_normal_count FROM biz_prompt_comment t1 LEFT JOIN biz_prompt_comment_complete t2_outer ON t1.comment_id = t2_outer.comment_id AND t2_outer.media_account_id = #{mediaAccountId} WHERE t1.del_flag = '0' AND t2_outer.comment_complete_id IS NULL AND t1.operate_group_id = ( /* 内部子查询：精准定位第一个符合条件的组ID */ SELECT tmp.operate_group_id FROM biz_prompt_comment tmp LEFT JOIN biz_prompt_comment_complete t2 ON tmp.comment_id = t2.comment_id AND t2.media_account_id = #{mediaAccountId} LEFT JOIN biz_prompt_template t3 ON tmp.prompt_id = t3.prompt_id WHERE tmp.del_flag = '0' AND t2.comment_complete_id IS NULL AND t3.template_type = #{platform} LIMIT 1 ) /* 这里的排序确保这一组内的数据按时间展示 */ ORDER BY t1.comment_id ASC
